title: 第8章 小姨子到了公司
content_zh:
天朝是一个讲究人情世故的国家，升职，并不全是看业绩，需要有人缘，还需要有上司关爱的眼神。钟晓飞的人缘不错，但他和李三石的关系并不好，他是南哥的人，自从南哥和李三石闹翻离开ty公司后，钟晓飞对升职已经不抱太大的希望。也的确，最近的两年，虽然他工作很努力，照理早应该被升职，但一直是原地踏步，现在突然的换了好运，所以钟晓飞一时有点不能理解。

一会，钟晓飞又想到了吴怡洁，一想到吴怡洁冷若冰霜的绝美面容，那一种即将升职的兴奋立刻就烟消云散了。他只觉得很惆怅，原来以为和女神认识了，接下来就有进一步发展的机会，但从女神冰冷的表情来看，他所想的一切都是奢望。

钟晓飞狠狠的摸了一下藏在裤兜里面的性感小内裤，就好像在摸着吴怡洁滑嫩的肌肤！

“晓飞，走，一起吃饭去。”同事陈昊走了过来。

陈昊二十多岁，是钟晓飞在公司里面的好朋友，两个人都是财经专业，又是同一批进入ty公司，平常相互照应，关系很好。老实说，钟晓飞在公司里面值得信任的朋友并不多。陈昊是一个。

陈昊长的很帅气，长卷的头发，英挺的鼻子，白白净净的，眼睛有点小，戴上金丝边的眼镜，看起来文质彬彬，标准的白领模样。

“不，是你请我!”陈昊眨眼睛笑，“我可是听说你马上就要升职了……”

“还不承认呢？李经理都找你了。”陈昊笑着说，“你要是高升了可得拉兄弟一把啊。”

“拉怎么行，起码要抱!”钟晓飞大笑。

ty公司有自己的内部食堂，饭菜可口，当然，你如果不愿意吃的话，公司附近也有很多高级的餐厅。钟晓飞在公司里面虽然不算是高薪，但和一般的工薪比起来，他的薪金还是很丰厚的。

手机响了，钟晓飞取出来一看是李小薇的号码.昨天不但帮李小薇买了生活用品，还给她换了一张本地的手机号。

“姐夫，我在你们公司楼下！”李小薇在手机那边兴奋的说。

“呀！”钟晓飞大吃一惊，一边疾步向楼下走，一边问，“不是不让你出来吗？你怎么出来了？”

“我来面试啊！”李小薇咯咯的笑。

钟晓飞想起来的，昨天在餐厅里面和吴怡洁见面的时候，吴怡洁答应给李小薇找工作的。

“谁呀，那么紧张？”陈昊笑着问。

“嗯……我小姨子……”犹豫了一下，钟晓飞回答。

“你小姨子？”陈昊惊讶的张大了嘴，“你不还没有结婚吗？怎么有小姨子了？”

“老家来的……”钟晓飞含含糊糊的说了一句，然后转头往楼下跑。

出了公司的大楼，钟晓飞伸长了脖子左右的看，正是中午12点，太阳正烈，温度正高，从凉爽空调的大楼里面走出来，热气扑面而来，蒸的钟晓飞满头大汗。

“姐夫！”公司门前的一棵大树下，李小薇撑着一把蓝色的小雨伞，正冲着他使劲的摇手。

钟晓飞跑了过去，“来也不先告诉我一声……”

“人家怕影响你工作嘛，”李小薇娇嗔着咯咯的笑。因为今天是来面试的，所以李小薇穿的比较正式，上身是一件白色的短袖t恤，藏住了高耸的双峰，露着雪白的小臂，下面是一条蓝白的牛仔裤，贴身的勾勒出她的美臀和长腿，说话的时候，两只大眼睛一闪又一闪的。

“嗯嗯。”钟晓飞吞了一口口水，“面试……还顺利吗？”

“你猜呢？”李小薇眨着大眼睛笑。

“我猜顺利。”傻子都知道这个答案。

“是非常的顺利！”李小薇纠正的娇笑，雀跃的说，“明天我就可以上班了。”

“啊？这么快？”钟晓飞真的惊讶了，ty公司可不是一般的公司，每年招聘的博士硕士海归一大堆，今天面试，明天就上班，是从来没有过的事情。

“怎么？你不相信吗姐夫？”李小薇娇嗔。

“相信相信。”钟晓飞磕头如捣蒜。

“那就行，”李小薇把手里的小雨伞抬高了，遮住自己和钟晓飞两个人，然后另一只手勾住了钟晓飞的右臂，在他的耳朵边吹气如兰的说，“姐夫，我真是太谢谢你了。要不是你，我肯定找不到这么好的工作。”

“哦哦，”钟晓飞的胳膊被两团软软的，弹弹的东西压着，一阵的心猿意马。

“你肯定跟招聘的那个人打招呼了，是不是？”李小薇兴奋的问。

“嗯嗯。”钟晓飞含含糊糊的回答，他在公司里面只是一个普通的小白领，而招聘的起码都是副主管级别的人物，他根本没有能力打招呼。能打招呼的只能是吴怡洁，不过这个情况不能跟李小薇明说，不然多没有面子。

“啊，ty公司！”李小薇一脸憧憬的看着面前的公司大楼，“我一直想到这样的大公司里面上班，想不到这么轻易的就实现了，咯咯，真是太好了。能和姐夫在一起，也能和吴姐姐在一起。”

“你见吴怡洁了？”钟晓飞问了一个非常重要的问题。

“当然啊。”李小薇娇笑着说，“就是吴姐姐早上给我打电话的，要不然我连ty公司在哪都不知道呢。”

“哦。”钟晓飞眼珠子直转，心说吴怡洁对小薇这么照顾，仅仅是因为她和小薇很投缘？还是有别的原因？比如说，吴怡洁想通过照顾小薇来接近自己……

这个猜测太荒谬，钟晓飞自己都忍不住的笑了。

“走吧姐夫，人家饿死了，我们庆祝一下去。”李小薇拉着钟晓飞走。

在公司附近的一家高级餐厅，两人在临窗的一张桌子坐下，要了饭菜。李小薇翻开菜单啪啪的点，非常的熟练，一点不犹豫。完了把菜单一合，跟服务生说，“好了，快点上就行了。”

钟晓飞看的目瞪口呆，心说你真是这一次到这里来吗？

“姐夫，你可不要心疼哦，等我正式上班有了钱，就不用你请我了。”李小薇眨着眼睛笑。

“姐夫不心疼，”钟晓飞其实很心疼的，但看着李小薇娇嗔可爱的模样，花太多的钱他也愿意。

一会，李小薇看着满满一桌的丰盛的美味菜肴大吞口水，然后吃的眉开眼笑。今天找到了工作，小薇的心情非常好，一边吃一边哼着小曲，手上把一只大龙虾的外壳剥掉，露出鲜嫩的虾肉，小舌头灵巧的一勾，就把虾肉卷进了小嘴里，一边向钟晓飞眨眼，一边享受的咀嚼，吃完了龙虾，＃＃＃了几下尖尖的手指头。

这＃＃＃手指头的动作，看得钟晓飞怦然心动，浮想联翩，忍不住的吞了一口的口水，低下头夹菜。

小薇的魅力太大了，还是不看的好，免得犯错误。

刚吃了一口菜，突然听见小薇娇呼了一声：“讨厌啦，姐夫，你快递餐纸给我。”

钟晓飞抬头看，原来，小薇吃的太快，脸上不小心沾上了一点菜汁。

“你帮我擦一下拉，我手上都是油。”小薇十指张开，娇嗔发嗲的说。

小薇微微前倾着身子，仰起绝美的粉脸，娇艳欲滴，香唇红润，长长的睫毛下，双眼微微的闭合，像是在偷看。钟晓飞的脑子腾了一下就热了，手有点抖，多亏是在公众场合，否则，他肯定控制不住。

“嗯，坐好了，姐夫给你擦。”钟晓飞咽了一口口水，定定心神。

小薇没有动，微噘的红唇有点等不及的撇了一下。

钟晓飞拿起餐纸轻轻的擦拭小薇粉脸上的菜汁，他的动作很轻很柔，小指间不经意的划过了小薇的粉脸，接着又碰触到了小薇的红唇，小薇轻轻的颤抖了一下，长长的睫毛抖动了抖动，一双灵动的大眼睛蓦地睁开，然后迅速的又闭上，这一瞥的暧昧和看的钟晓飞面红心跳，魂都散了，手里拿着餐纸，在小薇滑嫩的粉脸上来回的擦，一时舍不得移开。

“好了没姐夫？”小薇闭着大眼，嗲嗲的问。

“好了。”钟晓飞依依不舍的放下餐纸。

小薇睁开大眼，灵动的目光在钟晓飞的脸上转了两圈，雪白的小手摸摸自己的脸，”姐夫，你擦的真干净。”

“嗯嗯。”钟晓飞又吞了一口的口水。

在小薇在一起，每时每刻都能感受到诱惑。

吃完饭，从餐厅离开，“姐夫，明天我就要上班了，可我还没有几件像样的衣服呢？你带我去买好不好啊？”小薇嗲嗲的说。

这当然是借口，公司上班会派发一套定制的职业装。

“看在你挣钱也不多的情况上，我就少买点，嗯，就买一条裙子，一件衣服、一条裤子、一双鞋子，还有，再买一只小包包……”小薇板着手指头数，眼睛笑成了一轮弯月。

“好。”钟晓飞知道，今天肯定要大出血了。
content_en:
China is a country that pays attention to human relations and sophistication. Promotion is not all based on performance. It requires popularity and the caring eyes of the boss.Zhong Xiaofei is very popular, but his relationship with Li Sanshi is not good. He is from Brother Nan. Ever since Brother Nan fell out with Li Sanshi and left Ty Company, Zhong Xiaofei no longer has much hope for promotion.Indeed, in the past two years, although he had worked very hard and should have been promoted long ago, he had been standing still. Now he suddenly had good luck, so Zhong Xiaofei was a little confused for a while.

After a while, Zhong Xiaofei thought of Wu Yijie again. When he thought of Wu Yijie's cold and beautiful face, the excitement about being promoted immediately disappeared.He just felt melancholy. He originally thought that after getting to know the goddess, there would be opportunities for further development, but judging from the goddess's cold expression, everything he thought was a luxury.

Zhong Xiaofei fiercely touched the sexy panties hidden in his trouser pocket, as if he was touching Wu Yijie's smooth and tender skin!

"Xiaofei, let's go have dinner together." Colleague Chen Hao came over.

Chen Hao is in his twenties and is a good friend of Zhong Xiaofei in the company. They are both majoring in finance and entered the company in the same batch. They usually look after each other and have a good relationship.To be honest, Zhong Xiaofei doesn't have many trustworthy friends in the company.Chen Hao is one.

Chen Hao is very handsome, with long curly hair, a handsome nose, fair skin, and a little small eyes. He wears gold-rimmed glasses and looks elegant and has a standard white-collar look.

"No, you invited me!" Chen Hao blinked and smiled, "I heard that you are going to be promoted soon..."

"You still don't admit it? Manager Li is looking for you." Chen Hao said with a smile, "If you get promoted, you have to help your brothers."

"You can't pull me, at least I have to hug you!" Zhong Xiaofei laughed.

ty company has its own internal canteen with delicious food. Of course, if you don't want to eat, there are also many high-end restaurants near the company.Although Zhong Xiaofei's salary in the company is not high, compared with the average salary, his salary is still very generous.

The phone rang, Zhong Xiaofei took it out and saw that it was Li Xiaowei's number. Yesterday, he not only helped Li Xiaowei buy daily necessities, but also gave her a local mobile phone number.

"Brother-in-law, I'm downstairs in your company!" Li Xiaowei said excitedly on the phone.

"Yeah!" Zhong Xiaofei was shocked. He walked quickly downstairs and asked, "Didn't I let you come out? Why did you come out?"

"I'm here for the interview!" Li Xiaowei giggled.

Zhong Xiaofei remembered that when he met Wu Yijie in the restaurant yesterday, Wu Yijie promised to find a job for Li Xiaowei.

"Who is so nervous?" Chen Hao asked with a smile.

"Well...my sister-in-law..." Zhong Xiaofei answered after hesitating.

"Your sister-in-law?" Chen Hao opened his mouth in surprise, "Aren't you not married yet? Why do you have a sister-in-law?"

"I'm from my hometown..." Zhong Xiaofei said vaguely, then turned around and ran downstairs.

After leaving the company building, Zhong Xiaofei stretched his neck and looked around. It was exactly 12 noon. The sun was blazing and the temperature was high. When he walked out of the cool and air-conditioned building, the hot air hit his face, making Zhong Xiaofei sweat profusely.

"Brother-in-law!" Under a big tree in front of the company, Li Xiaowei was holding a small blue umbrella and waving her hands vigorously at him.

Zhong Xiaofei ran over, "You didn't even tell me first..."

"They are afraid that it will affect your work," Li Xiaowei giggled coquettishly.Because she was here for an interview today, Li Xiaowei was dressed more formally. She wore a white short-sleeved T-shirt on her upper body, which hid her towering breasts and exposed her snow-white forearms. Below was a pair of blue and white jeans, which closely outlined her beautiful buttocks and long legs. When she spoke, her two big eyes flashed again and again.

"Yeah." Zhong Xiaofei swallowed, "The interview... went well?"

"What do you think?" Li Xiaowei blinked her big eyes and smiled.

"I guess it's going well." All fools know this answer.

"It went very smoothly!" Li Xiaowei corrected her with a sweet smile and said happily, "I can go to work tomorrow."

"Ah? So fast?" Zhong Xiaofei was really surprised. TY Company is not an ordinary company. It recruits a lot of overseas graduates with PhDs and master's degrees every year. It has never happened before for interviews today and starting work tomorrow.

"What? Don't you believe it, brother-in-law?" Li Xiaowei said coquettishly.

"Believe it, believe it." Zhong Xiaofei kowtowed as if pounding garlic.

"That's okay," Li Xiaowei raised the small umbrella in her hand to cover herself and Zhong Xiaofei, then hooked her other hand on Zhong Xiaofei's right arm, blew into his ear and said softly, "Brother-in-law, I'm so grateful to you. If it weren't for you, I would definitely not be able to find such a good job."

"Oh," Zhong Xiaofei's arm was pressed by two soft and bouncy things, and he felt distracted for a while.

"You must have said hello to the person recruiting, right?" Li Xiaowei asked excitedly.

"Yeah." Zhong Xiaofei answered vaguely. He was just an ordinary white-collar worker in the company, and the people being recruited were at least deputy director level, so he didn't have the ability to say hello.The only one who can say hello is Wu Yijie, but she can't tell Li Xiaowei about this situation, otherwise she will lose face.

"Ah, Ty Company!" Li Xiaowei looked at the company building in front of her with longing, "I have always wanted to work in such a big company, but I didn't expect it to be possible so easily. Haha, it's great. I can be with my brother-in-law, and I can also be with Sister Wu."

"Have you met Wu Yijie?" Zhong Xiaofei asked a very important question.

"Of course." Li Xiaowei said with a sweet smile, "It was Sister Wu who called me this morning, otherwise I wouldn't even know where Ty Company is."

"Oh." Zhong Xiaofei's eyes rolled, and he thought to himself that Wu Yijie took such good care of Xiaowei just because she and Xiaowei were very close to each other?Or is there another reason?For example, Wu Yijie wants to get closer to herself by taking care of Xiaowei...

This guess was so ridiculous that Zhong Xiaofei couldn't help but laugh.

"Come on, brother-in-law, we are starving to death, let's celebrate." Li Xiaowei pulled Zhong Xiaofei away.

In a high-end restaurant near the company, the two sat down at a table near the window and ordered food.Li Xiaowei opened the menu and clicked on it, very skillfully and without any hesitation.After finishing, he put the menu together and said to the waiter, "Okay, just hurry up and get it served."

Zhong Xiaofei was dumbfounded and thought to himself, are you really here this time?

"Brother-in-law, don't feel bad. When I officially start working and have money, you won't need to invite me." Li Xiaowei blinked and smiled.

"Brother-in-law, I don't feel sorry for her," Zhong Xiaofei actually felt sorry for her, but looking at Li Xiaowei's cute and cute appearance, he was willing to spend too much money.

After a while, Li Xiaowei looked at the table full of sumptuous and delicious dishes, swallowed her saliva, and then ate with a smile on her face.I found a job today. Xiaowei was in a very good mood. She hummed a tune while eating. She peeled off the shell of a large lobster with her hands, revealing the tender shrimp meat. With a deft move of her little tongue, she rolled the shrimp meat into her mouth. She winked at Zhong Xiaofei and chewed with enjoyment. After finishing the lobster, she clicked her pointed fingers a few times.

The movement of ###'s fingers made Zhong Xiaofei's heart beat wildly and his thoughts wander. He couldn't help but swallow a mouthful of saliva and lowered his head to pick up the food.

Xiaowei's charm is too great, so it's better not to look at her to avoid making mistakes.

Just after taking a bite of the food, I suddenly heard Xiaowei shouting: "I hate it, brother-in-law, please express the meal paper to me."

Zhong Xiaofei looked up and saw that Xiaowei ate too quickly and accidentally got a little vegetable juice on her face.

"Please wipe it for me, my hands are all oily." Xiaowei spread her fingers and said coquettishly.

Xiaowei leaned forward slightly and raised her beautiful pink face, which was very delicate and charming, with rosy lips. Under her long eyelashes, her eyes were slightly closed, as if she was peeking.Zhong Xiaofei's head started to heat up, and his hands were shaking a little. Fortunately, he was in a public place, otherwise, he would definitely not be able to control it.

"Well, sit down and let my brother-in-law wipe it for you." Zhong Xiaofei swallowed and calmed down.

Xiaowei didn't move, her slightly pursed red lips curled up impatiently.

Zhong Xiaofei picked up the dinner paper and gently wiped the vegetable juice from Xiao Wei's pink face. His movements were very light and gentle. His little finger inadvertently crossed Xiao Wei's pink face, and then touched Xiao Wei's red lips. Xiao Wei trembled slightly, and her long eyelashes trembled.Shaking, a pair of big and smart eyes suddenly opened, and then quickly closed again. The ambiguous glance made Zhong Xiaofei blush and his heart beat, and his soul disappeared. He held the dinner paper in his hand and wiped it back and forth on Xiaowei's smooth pink face. He couldn't bear to move away for a moment.

"Are you okay, brother-in-law?" Xiaowei closed her big eyes and asked coquettishly.

"Okay." Zhong Xiaofei reluctantly put down the meal paper.

Xiaowei opened her big eyes, and her smart gaze turned twice on Zhong Xiaofei's face. She touched her face with her white hands, "Brother-in-law, you wiped it so cleanly."

"Yeah." Zhong Xiaofei swallowed another mouthful of saliva.

When you are with Xiaowei, you can feel the temptation every moment.

After finishing the meal, he left the restaurant and said, "Brother-in-law, I have to go to work tomorrow, but I don't have a few decent clothes yet? Can you take me to buy them?" Xiaowei said coquettishly.

This is of course an excuse. The company will distribute a set of customized business attire when working.

"Seeing as you don't make much money, I'll buy less. Well, I'll just buy a skirt, a dress, a pair of pants, a pair of shoes, and a small bag..." Xiaowei counted on her fingers, her eyes turning into crescent moons with smiles.

"Okay." Zhong Xiaofei knew that he would be bleeding heavily today.
